deadline.value: Departmental deadline Dec 15, 2026: applications by then get full consideration for all scholarships and funding. Later applications are still considered, but may be eligible only for some scholarships. There is no set deadline for admission itself.
deadline.quote: We strongly encourage applicants to submit their application by 15 December 2026, which is the departmental deadline. | Applications submitted after the deadline will still be considered; however, eligibility may be limited to specific scholarships | There are no set deadlines for applications to the Postgraduate degrees in the Department of Physics

supervisor.value: University guidance says to contact a potential supervisor before applying. Physics lets you apply to a research area and list the staff you would like to consider your application, and does not state that prior agreement is required.
supervisor.quote: If you are applying to a research area rather than a pre-defined project, please indicate the relevant research area(s) (from the five available) and any research staff you would like your application to be considered by.

also.quote: Contact a potential supervisor whose expertise matches your proposed research project. Departments are happy to discuss research opportunities and supervisory support before application.

funding.value: Funded studentships (UK Research Councils, external sponsors, Durham) are typically available in all research areas; apply by Dec 15, 2026 for full consideration for all scholarships and funding
funding.quote: Funded studentships are typically available for PhDs in all research areas, supported by UK Research Councils, external sponsors and Durham University.

also.quote: Applications received by this date will receive full consideration for all available scholarships and funding opportunities.

entry_route.value: PhD entry with a First-class honours Bachelor's, or at least a 2:1 integrated Master's or a Master's degree (or equivalent)
entry_route.quote: For entry to a PhD you will be required to have achieved a First Class honours Bachelor's degree, or at least a 2:1 Integrated Master's degree or a Master's degree in an appropriate subject, from a recognised university (or equivalent).

toefl_min.value: Physics PGR uses English Band B. TOEFL iBT tests from Jan 21, 2026: 4.5 with no component under 4; earlier tests: 80 with no component under 20. IELTS 6.5 with no component under 6.0
toefl_min.quote: Tests taken before 21 Jan 2026 | 80 with no component under 20 | Tests taken from 21 Jan 2026 | 4.5 with no component under 4 | 6.5 with no component under 6.0

also.quote: Physics Study level Language level Undergraduate BAND B Postgraduate Taught (PGT) BAND B Postgraduate Research (PGR) BAND B

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with no component under 6.0 (English Band B).

notes: The department advises not submitting before mid-October because a new admissions system has just gone live. One application covers several projects or research areas.
